plugin.name: mm_pastebin
plugin.author: Ferdinand
plugin.purpose: send the clipboard to dpaste.com after confirmation
plugin.description:
Uploads the clipboard to dpaste.com as an unlisted, expiring paste -- after showing a confirmation window so nothing is sent by mistake.
* pastebin -- preview & send the clipboard (expires in 1 week) * pastebin 1d -- expire in 1 day (also: 1w, 1m)
On success the paste URL is printed (clickable) and copied to the clipboard, ready to share.
Requires TLS: always available on MacMUSH; on MUSHclient install LuaSec. Keep mm_http.lua and mm_pastebin.lua in the same folder as this plugin.

muclient.script:
local COLOURS = { text = "silver", dim = "gray", link = "cornflowerblue", error = "tomato", background = "", -- empty string = the client's default output background }
-- Miniwindow colours are numeric 0xBBGGRR (BGR); ColourNameToRGB is -- avoided because older MacMUSH builds only knew 16 colour names. local WIN = { bg = 0x1E1610, frame = 0x8A7A6A, title = 0xF0E8E0, dim = 0x9A9A9A, preview = 0xD0D0D0, button = 0x503C28, button_frame = 0xA08860, button_text = 0xF0E8E0, }
local function file_exists(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then f:close() return true end return false end
local plugin_dir = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 20) or "" assert(file_exists(plugin_dir .. "mm_http.lua"), "mm_pastebin: mm_http.lua must sit next to mm_pastebin.xml") assert(file_exists(plugin_dir .. "mm_pastebin.lua"), "mm_pastebin: mm_pastebin.lua must sit next to mm_pastebin.xml") package.loaded.mm_http = nil package.loaded.mm_pastebin = nil package.path = plugin_dir .. "?.lua;" .. package.path local http = require "mm_http" local pastebin = require "mm_pastebin"
local WIN_ID = "z_pastebin_" .. GetPluginID() local FONT = "f" local PREVIEW_LINES = 12 local PREVIEW_COLS = 78 local PAD = 10
local client local pending -- in-flight request handle, nil when idle local snapshot -- { content, expires_value, expires_label } awaiting confirm local window_open = false
local function note(style, text) ColourNote(COLOURS[style] or COLOURS.text, COLOURS.background, text) end
local pump_scheduled = false
local function schedule_pump() if pump_scheduled then return end pump_scheduled = true DoAfterSpecial(0.1, "pastebin_pump()", sendto.script) end
function pastebin_pump() pump_scheduled = false if client and client:tick() then schedule_pump() end end
local function ensure_client() if not client then client = http.new() end end
local function close_window() if window_open then WindowShow(WIN_ID, false) WindowDelete(WIN_ID) window_open = false end end
local function output_font() -- reuse the output window's font so the preview matches the game text local name = GetInfo(20) if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then name = "Courier New" end local size = tonumber(GetInfo(21)) or 10 if size < 8 or size > 18 then size = 10 end return name, size end
local function show_window() local pv = pastebin.preview(snapshot.content, PREVIEW_LINES, PREVIEW_COLS) local font_name, font_size = output_font()
-- create tiny, set the font, measure, then create at the real size WindowCreate(WIN_ID, 0, 0, 1, 1, miniwin.pos_center_all, 0, WIN.bg) WindowFont(WIN_ID, FONT, font_name, font_size) local line_h = WindowFontInfo(WIN_ID, FONT, 1)
local title = "Send clipboard to dpaste.com?" local stats = string.format("%d line%s, %d bytes -- expires %s", pv.total_lines, pv.total_lines == 1 and "" or "s", pv.bytes, snapshot.expires_label) local more = pv.truncated and string.format("... +%d more lines", pv.total_lines - #pv.lines) or nil
local text_w = math.max( WindowTextWidth(WIN_ID, FONT, title, true), WindowTextWidth(WIN_ID, FONT, stats, true)) for _, l in ipairs(pv.lines) do text_w = math.max(text_w, WindowTextWidth(WIN_ID, FONT, l, true)) end local width = math.min(600, math.max(420, text_w + PAD * 2)) local button_h = line_h + 8 local height = PAD + line_h * 2 + 6 + (#pv.lines + (more and 1 or 0)) * line_h + 8 + button_h + PAD
WindowCreate(WIN_ID, 0, 0, width, height, miniwin.pos_center_all, 0, WIN.bg) WindowFont(WIN_ID, FONT, font_name, font_size) WindowRectOp(WIN_ID, miniwin.rect_frame, 0, 0, width, height, WIN.frame)
local y = PAD WindowText(WIN_ID, FONT, title, PAD, y, 0, 0, WIN.title, true) y = y + line_h WindowText(WIN_ID, FONT, stats, PAD, y, 0, 0, WIN.dim, true) y = y + line_h + 6 for _, l in ipairs(pv.lines) do WindowText(WIN_ID, FONT, l, PAD, y, 0, 0, WIN.preview, true) y = y + line_h end if more then WindowText(WIN_ID, FONT, more, PAD, y, 0, 0, WIN.dim, true) y = y + line_h end y = y + 8
local function button(id, label, x, callback, tooltip) local w = WindowTextWidth(WIN_ID, FONT, label, true) + 24 WindowRectOp(WIN_ID, miniwin.rect_fill, x, y, x + w, y + button_h, WIN.button) WindowRectOp(WIN_ID, miniwin.rect_frame, x, y, x + w, y + button_h, WIN.button_frame) WindowText(WIN_ID, FONT, label, x + 12, y + 4, 0, 0, WIN.button_text, true) WindowAddHotspot(WIN_ID, id, x, y, x + w, y + button_h, "", "", "", "", callback, tooltip, miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) return w end
local send_w = button("send", "Send", PAD, "pastebin_send_click", "Upload to dpaste.com") button("cancel", "Cancel", PAD + send_w + 10, "pastebin_cancel_click", "Close without sending")
WindowShow(WIN_ID, true) window_open = true end
local function do_upload() local bytes = #snapshot.content local label = snapshot.expires_label local opts = pastebin.build_request(snapshot.content, snapshot.expires_value) snapshot = nil opts.callback = function(resp) pending = nil local url, err = pastebin.parse_response(resp) if not url then note("error", "pastebin: upload failed: " .. err) return end ColourTell(COLOURS.text, COLOURS.background, "pastebin: ") Hyperlink(url, url, "Open paste", COLOURS.link, COLOURS.background, 1) Note("") note("dim", "pastebin: expires " .. label .. " -- link copied to clipboard") SetClipboard(url) end pending = client:request(opts) schedule_pump() note("dim", string.format("pastebin: uploading %d bytes ...", bytes)) end
function pastebin_send_click(flags, hotspot_id) if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_lh_mouse) == 0 then return end close_window() do_upload() end
function pastebin_cancel_click(flags, hotspot_id) if bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_lh_mouse) == 0 then return end close_window() snapshot = nil note("dim", "pastebin: cancelled -- nothing sent") end
function pastebin_command(name, line, wildcards) ensure_client() if not client:tls_available() then note("error", "pastebin: HTTPS unavailable -- install LuaSec to use this plugin") return end if pending then note("dim", "pastebin: an upload is already in progress") return end local value, label = pastebin.parse_expiry(wildcards[1]) if not value then note("error", "pastebin: " .. label) return end local content = GetClipboard() or "" if string.match(content, "^%s*$") then note("dim", "pastebin: clipboard is empty -- copy some text first") return end if #content > pastebin.MAX_BYTES then note("error", string.format( "pastebin: clipboard is %.0f KB -- the limit is %.0f KB", #content / 1024, pastebin.MAX_BYTES / 1024)) return end snapshot = { content = content, expires_value = value, expires_label = label } close_window() -- re-running pastebin refreshes the snapshot and window show_window() end
function OnPluginClose() if client then client:cancel_all() end close_window() end
function OnPluginDisable() if client then client:cancel_all() end close_window() end
